notes.title: Bug Fix: Welcome to Campus Scene
notes.notes:
We’ve just released a patch to fix an issue affecting the[b] Meow Moments: Welcome to Campus[/b] scene.

When we added the new [b]Music Festival[/b] scene, we unintentionally replaced [b]Welcome to Campus[/b] with a faulty version. Players who entered the scene during this period may have encountered[b] a purple background, missing balloons, and some missing characters.
[/b]
The original version of Welcome to Campus has now been restored and should work correctly again.

⚠️ Important: Only players who started the Welcome to Campus scene between July 16 and July 18 will need to restart the scene, which will reset progress for that scene. We’re very sorry for the inconvenience.

Thank you so much for playing Meow Moments: Celebrating Together and for your continued support. Your feedback means a lot to us! 💛🐾

notes.title: 🎓 New Meow Moments DLC + A Whole New Game! Launching April 28 🐾
notes.notes:
Hey cozy cat lovers! 💖

We’re thrilled to announce two special releases coming your way on April 28, 2025 — a brand-new DLC for Meow Moments: Celebrating Together and the debut of our brand-new coloring pixel art game!

[h2]🎓 Meow Moments: Welcome to Campus – New DLC[/h2]
Time to head back to school — cat style! 🐱📚

In our upcoming DLC, Welcome to Campus, join your favorite feline friends as they dive into student life. From lively study sessions under the trees to creative clubs and athletic activities, this cozy university scene is full of knowledge, curiosity, and paws-itively delightful moments.

As always, take your time, enjoy the search, and pop a few balloons along the way. 🧠🎈

🗓️ Launching April 28th as a DLC for Meow Moments: Celebrating Together!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3614660/Meow_Moments_Welcome_to_Campus/

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/6e6ab60ea0911330a04dc0f6327184de6fb8f13c.jpg[/img]

[h2]🎨 Coloring Cats: Sports with Friends – A Whole New Cozy Game![/h2]
We’re also excited to unveil the first game in our brand-new series: Coloring Cats!

📸 Coloring Cats: Sports with Friends invites you to help Buddy and Lucky bring their sports photos to life — color by color, pixel by pixel — in a chill and heartwarming experience.

✨ What to expect: 🖼️ 10 sports-themed photos filled with friendship and fun
🎨 Over 60 characters to paint
🖱️ Intuitive tools like the Eye and Lock buttons to help you relax
🎧 A peaceful soundtrack by Taty Jaques
🎨 Pixel art crafted by Kátia Numakura
📸 Complete your photo album, one cozy memory at a time

👉 Visit the Steam page and wishlist it now!

notes.title: Lots of features to Search 🐱🔍! And 3 Days to the Olympicats DLC!
notes.notes:
To complete the scene in Meow Moments, you need to:  Pop 101 balloons 🎈, Find 101 kittens 🐱, Find 101 diverse characters 🌟
The cats and characters to be found are shown in the top panel. Find one, and the next one will appear.

Worried it's too challenging? Don't be! [b]You have many resources at hand[/b] if you wish:

[list]
[*]  Zoom In and Out: Adjust the camera and move it along the scene for a better view.
[*]  See the Full Character: If a character in the top panel is large, hover the mouse over it to see it fully.
[*]  Switch Characters: Click on a character in the top bar to switch to a different target.
[*]  Enter Feline Focus Mode: Click the magnifier icon for a panoramic view of the whole scene. Search it with the magnifier and watch for signs when it finds something!
[*]  More or less details: Select between more detailed or cleaner characters in the top bar by choosing your "Search Hint Style" in the options.[/list]
Enjoy a pleasing and relaxing search experience, tailored to your preferences! 🌟 We can't wait for you to dive in and explore all the delightful details.

notes.title: Olympicats DLC: 4 Days to Go 💡 Creative Tips and Tricks! 💡
notes.notes:
Get inspired with tips and tricks for creating stunning scenes in the Community and Creative Maker! Imagine what you can do with all the new Olympicats assets! ✨

[olist]
[*] [b]Mind the Perspective and Proportion:[/b] Use the editor tools to build the scene you envision.
[*] [b]Unique Characters:[/b] You can't use a findable character more than once (it would be impossible to play the level), but you can repeat scenario items.
[*] [b]Hide Smartly:[/b] You can't hide a findable character behind another one or a scenario item, but you can place balloons over them.
[*] [b]Engage with Your Cover, Title, and Description:[/b] These are great ways to introduce your scene and pique the community's interest.
[*] [b]Mix and Match:[/b] Use items from different scenes to create new and exciting situations. The possibilities are endless!
[*] [b]Recurring Characters:[/b] Some characters appear in multiple scenes (New Year, Valentine's Day, and Olympicats). Have you noticed which ones? Create a story with them!
[/olist]

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi! 
Thanks for playing the game and for your support!
This update fixes a bug that prevented players from sharing their scenes on Steam Workshop under certain conditions.
We're sorry for the inconvenience.

If you have created a new scene before, tried to share it and it didn't work, please do this to share it - after installing this update: 
- edit the scene; 
- save it;
- go back to My creations screen and play the scene; 
- go back to My creations and share it again. 
You should see a link to view it on Steam Workshop (and eventually a link to accept Steam Workshop Terms and Conditions to make your scene public).

Enjoy it!
